next.reason: The two content formats (spaces, sign, currency string, digits with grouping and decimal separators, trailing +/-/CR/DB) match §2023:15.68.3 AR4, and §2023:15.68.3 AR2 restates cs as argument-2's currency string. But 1989 allows only 'a nonnumeric literal or alphanumeric data item' with uppercase CR/DB, while 2023 allows 'category alphanumeric or national' (§2023:15.68.3 AR1) and CR/DB 'in uppercase or lowercase' (§2023:15.68.3 AR4), plus a LOCALE form (§2023:15.68.3 AR5). Looser.
